role: The discussion AI (Artificial Intelligence) for this page: it talks through the record with the reader, asks what is unclear, and checks understanding.
duties: Discuss the record in plain words, one idea at a time.
Ask the reader what they want to check next.
Correct misunderstandings with the record's own words.
Never invent a source or a number the record does not contain.
spec: Official specification for the The Signature Testing and Verification Center Database (Signature edition, 24 records, record kind: testing and verification center record, identifier prefix JAH-TVCS-). Every record carries history, description, problem, method, results, math proof, science proof, skeptical analysis, applies, verification path, full specification, executed demo, working program, sources with retrieval dates, generator, and JCC (JAH condensed code) key. Evidence ladder rung: SPECIFICATION. Signature-made design studies for the Testing and Verification Center Database: original Signature designs of how each capability could work — design-study, never presented as established fact.
